title: Pure Bujin
summary: Bujin cards with Number F0: Utopic Draco Future, generic Rank 4s, Links, and staples. Bujin pairs Level 4 LIGHT Beast-Warrior Bujins on the field with Beast and Winged Beast Bujingi monsters that protect them from the hand and GY, accelerated by the 2021 support wave.

summary.title: Starters
points: Bujin Torifune Tributes itself to Special Summon 2 Bujin monsters of different Types in Defense Position from the Deck, and automatically equips itself from the GY to any Bujin Xyz Monster you summon to banish monsters it destroys by battle.

Bujin Mahitotsu sends another Bujin card from the hand to the GY to Special Summon itself, then either discards a Bujin to add a differently named Bujin from the GY to the hand or banishes a Bujin from the GY to send a differently named Bujin from the Deck to the GY.
Bujin Yamato searches any Bujin monster during your End Phase and then discards 1 card, loading a Bujingi directly into the GY while keeping Bujingi Crane in hand.

summary.title: Opening: Bujin Torifune (1-Card Line)
steps: Normal Summon Bujin Torifune and Tribute it to Special Summon a Beast-Warrior Bujin (such as Bujin Mikazuchi or Arasuda) alongside a Beast or Winged Beast Bujingi (such as Bujingi Turtle or Quilin) from the Deck.

Link Summon Bujinki Ahashima using the two monsters to Special Summon 1 monster from the hand and 1 from the GY with the same Level, and immediately Xyz Summon Bujintei Susanowo (with Torifune equipping itself from the GY).

Detach from Susanowo to search Bujin Mahitotsu or send a Bujingi to the GY; Special Summon Mahitotsu to extend into a second Rank 4 Xyz (Bujintei Kagutsuchi or Tsukuyomi) and overlay two non-Number Xyz into Number F0: Utopic Draco Future.

summary.title: Hand & GY Bujingi Relics
summary.text: While you control a Beast-Warrior Bujin (Yamato, Mahitotsu, Mikazuchi, Arasuda, Hirume, Susanowo, or Kagutsuchi), the Bujingi monsters act as hidden disruption from your hand and GY. From the hand, Bujingi Crane discards itself during damage calculation to double a Beast-Warrior Bujin's original ATK. From the GY, Bujingi Turtle banishes itself to negate an effect that targets a Bujin, Bujingi Hare banishes itself to prevent a Bujin from being destroyed by battle or card effect, Bujingi Sinyou boosts a battling Bujin's ATK by the opponent's monster's ATK, and Bujingi Quilin banishes itself to destroy a face-up card.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Bujintei Susanowo detaches 1 material each turn to either search any Bujin monster or send it to the GY, and can attack every monster the opponent controls once each.
Bujintei Kagutsuchi mills 5 cards on Xyz Summon to load the GY with Bujingis and detaches a material to protect any Beast-Warrior Bujin from destruction.
Bujinki Ahashima facilitates instant Rank 4 Xyz Summons and pops a Spell/Trap in the opponent's zone whenever a Rank 4 Xyz it points to detaches a material.
Number F0: Utopic Draco Future cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects and negates an opposing monster effect once per turn while taking control of that monster if it was on the field.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Bujincandescence makes all Beast-Warrior Bujins you control unaffected by the opponent's card effects outside the Battle Phase, sends a Bujin from hand or field to the GY once per turn to negate a face-up card, and revives a Bujin in the End Phase by sending itself to the GY.
Bujin Regalia - The Sword recovers a Bujin from your GY to the hand or returns a banished Bujin to the GY to re-enable Turtle, Hare, or Quilin.
